turn_text: From our headquarters in Florida's Capital City, this is FSACAS, the official podcast of the Florida Sheriffs Association. Congresswoman Lee serves on the House Judiciary and Homeland Security Committees. Her main focus on these committees includes government accountability and transparency, and protecting our nation from threats both abroad and at home.
